     /add-dir                            Add or list an additional workspace directory
     /auto                               Never Ask mode: everything runs and is decided automatically; only plans in Plan mode wait for your review.
     /btw                                Ask a forked side agent a question
     /check-kimi-code-docs               Answer questions about the Kimi Code product using the official documentation — CLI usage, configuration, slash commands, features, membership and quota, A...
     /compact                            Compact the conversation context
     /copy                               Copy the last assistant message to the clipboard
     /custom-theme                       Create or edit a kimi-code custom color theme — a JSON file under the resolved KIMI_CODE_HOME data directory that recolors the TUI. Use when the user wants...
     /desktop (/install-desktop)         Open the Kimi Code desktop app page in your browser
     /editor                             Set the external editor for Ctrl-G
     /effort (/thinking)                 Switch thinking effort
     /exit (/quit, /q)                   Exit the application
     /experiments (/experimental)        Manage experimental features
     /export-debug-zip                   Export current session as a debug ZIP archive
     /export-md (/export)                Export current session as a Markdown file
     /feedback (/bug)                    Send feedback to make Kimi Code better
     /fork                               Fork the current session into a copy without switching to it
     /goal                               Start or manage an autonomous goal
